utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to check what tools we still need. I can swing by and help out, if that’s still useful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’d be really helpful. I’m checking the list now, and we can compare notes on what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll grab my notes and see what’s left on my end. If you tell me the missing items, I can head over and pick up a few.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Could you help spread the word and let folks know what’s needed? I’ll keep the list updated as we go.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I can spread the word around the block and tell people to check the updated list. Just send me the latest needs when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going — do you need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m managing for now, thank you. If I hit a snag, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Glad to hear it. I’m around if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word fast and make sure folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — do you want me to note the location and time for the repair drive so I can share it accurately?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes please — send me the location and time, and I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Hana — happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam. I’m checking the details first—what items are you able to help repair, and when would you be available?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with small furniture fixes, loose hinges, and basic patching or touch-ups. I’m free most evenings this week, and I can do Saturday morning too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Leo — thank you. I could use help sorting donations and checking which repairs are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do both. I’ll sort the donations first, then check the repair list with you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Bo — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive and keep things moving. What do you want me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with a simple sign-up list and a quick flyer for the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll draft the sign-up list and a neighbor-friendly flyer, then we can review them together before sharing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the pickup time and who’s handling the drop-off so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep it simple: I’ll confirm the pickup time, and I’ll handle the drop-off unless you’d prefer to take that part. Then we’ll both know exactly what’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—please confirm the pickup time, and I’m fine with you handling drop-off. If anything changes, just let me know so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s coming along—need me to swing by and drop anything off?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be really helpful—I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I think they still need tools and a few supplies. If you can swing by, I’d be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll stop by and bring what I can. If you hear anything specific they still need, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on our supplies list for the repair drive. Tell me what’s still needed, and I’ll track it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sounds good—can you confirm you’ll update me if anything changes on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll keep the list updated and let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Jules — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s awesome, Gus — a mix of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a drill would help a lot. I’ll swing by and label everything so it’s easy to hand out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll set those aside for you, and I can throw in a tape measure too if that helps. Just let me know when you’re coming by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line up the repair drive around the school schedule—what day and time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s so kind of you, Faye — I was thinking Saturday morning, maybe 9 to 11, so folks can swing by before the day gets busy.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning, 9 to 11 works well for me. I’ll check the school calendar and help spread the word once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school schedule—what time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — we’re aiming to start at 9:00 AM, but I can shift things a bit if the school timing needs it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:00 AM should work best for us—I can plan around drop-off and be there after the school run. If you need any help with setup, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we already decide which items go on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t think we’ve settled it yet—let me check the list details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—can you send me the list details when you’ve checked, so I know what to include?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for sure — folks are gathering supplies and lining up fixes now. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — you’ll confirm the exact details when you get them, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and can use your help if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Rosa — I’m up for it. What supplies do you need me to keep an eye on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’d love for you to watch for basic tool kits, duct tape, spare lightbulbs, and batteries. If you spot any donated extension cords or a decent hand truck, those would be a huge help too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — even a little help counts. I’ll keep it low-key and handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I appreciate you keeping it quiet — I’ll do what I can and stay out of the way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I think folks are still gathering tools and volunteers, and it’s coming along nicely.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds encouraging — I’ve just been hearing the scraps, so I’m glad it’s moving along. If you hear any concrete needs, let me know and I’ll pass them on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive—just point me to what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Bo. I’ll grab the list and point you to the first thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — send me the first item, and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Sam — I’m here for the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll help keep track.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — I’m glad you’re here. We still need to sort the donated parts, check the tool table, and make a quick list of any unfinished repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll sort the donated parts, check the tool table, and help make that list of unfinished repairs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been meaning to tell folks — the repair drive is this Saturday, and you should come by! If you know anyone with a wobbly chair or a finicky lamp, send them along too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Count me in — I’ve got a wrench set and a soldering iron I can bring. I’ll spread the word about the chair and lamp folks too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Gus — bring them along! I’ll keep passing the word, and if you hear of anyone with a busted toaster or a loose cabinet hinge, send them my way too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I’m sorry I’m late—what do you need me to help with on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries, Dane — I just need help loading the boxes by the community center and then dropping the tools off at Mrs. Patel’s garage.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll head to the community center now and help load the boxes, then I can take the tools over to Mrs. Patel’s garage.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely. I’ll keep an ear out for any new updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you keeping watch—just let me know if you hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Rey. I’m heading out now, and I’ll report back if I hear anything useful.
